name: TEMPRO Heating & Cooling Inc
what_they_do: Family-owned HVAC contractor in North Brunswick Township doing heating and AC repair, maintenance, installation and replacement, plus ductwork, ductless mini-splits and thermostats, with 24/7 emergency service. Sells maintenance agreements and offers financing and free estimates.
customers: Homeowners and businesses across North Brunswick, New Brunswick, East Brunswick, South Brunswick, Edison, Piscataway and nearby towns

size_signals.signal: Site claims over 15 years of experience and 'family owned & operated'; a projects page shows commercial work
Procore network profile exists for TEMPRO INC as a North Brunswick company, implying commercial project work
Dedicated service pages for at least 20 services (AC repair, furnace repair, ductwork, thermostats, maintenance agreements) - content investment beyond a one-truck shop

listing.reviews: count not shown in limited Maps view (site claims 4.9 from 300+ reviews)

website_review.primary_cta: Sticky 'Emergency HVAC Service - Call (551) 451-1999' bar, 'REQUEST A FREE ESTIMATE' and 'SCHEDULE SERVICE TODAY' buttons
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Fluent Forms quote/service request form (name, email, phone, service dropdown, description); 'Schedule Service' just routes to that contact page - no calendar or booking platform
website_review.trust_signals: 4.9 Google reviews badge, HomeAdvisor top-rated badge, A+ BBB-style 'accredited business' badge, licensed & insured, financing available, service/projects pages with photos
website_review.out_of_date_signs: None obvious - WordPress site with 2026-dated content in the page schema; minor glitch where the review-count counter renders a bare '4' before the 4.9 rating on mobile
website_review.search_basics: Title 'Tempro Heating & Cooling | HVAC Services North Brunswick NJ' and matching meta description; ~20 separate service URLs, plus /about-us/, /reviews/, /projects/, /contact/
top_issues: No real online scheduling - 'Schedule Service' lands on a generic contact form, so someone still has to call back to set a time
Home page does not state a price range or diagnostic fee anywhere
Review-count display glitch on mobile ('4' next to 4.9) undermines the strongest trust signal

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: profile has HVAC contractor category, published hours (closed/opens 8 AM), photos, phone matching the site, and an owner post from the previous day; robots.txt explicitly Allow-lists OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended and others. Answerable: hours as text on the page (Mon-Fri 8am-6pm), service descriptions and service area towns written out, 15+ years and review counts stated; a schema.org @graph (WebPage/Organization/LocalBusiness) is present and consistent with the page. Bookable: labelled Fluent Forms fields with a service dropdown and no CAPTCHA, but nothing that reserves a time slot - an agent can request, not book.

operations_signals.signal: 24/7 emergency availability advertised while the office hours are Mon-Fri 8-6 - after-hours calls currently go to whoever answers
Free-estimate and schedule-service CTAs both funnel to one form, so all quotes are manual callbacks
Owner posts to Google frequently (post '20 hours ago'), showing active marketing effort without an automated scheduling layer behind it

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add genuine online scheduling (arrival windows + service type) behind the existing 'Schedule Service' button, with SMS confirmations and reminders
top_opportunities.evidence: The Schedule Service button only opens a contact form; nothing on the site reserves a time

top_opportunities.opportunity: AI intake agent that triages emergency vs routine calls, captures the address and system details, and books into the schedule 24/7
top_opportunities.evidence: Site advertises 24/7 emergency service but office hours are Mon-Fri 8-6 with no automated intake

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated post-job review requests to keep the 4.9-rating asset growing, and fix the review-count display glitch
top_opportunities.evidence: Reviews are front-and-centre marketing on the home page (4.9, 300+) but no capture mechanism is visible, and the mobile badge renders a stray '4'

scores.reasons: Site and profile are already strong (schema, AI-crawler allow-list, service pages, reviews); the real gap is booking and after-hours intake, which is more work than a quick fix; an established HVAC contractor with commercial work can pay.
